actual_request.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Produce ONE high-definition transparent game sprite frame. Image 1 is immutable snow summoner girl identity. Image 2 is approved clean rounded Daoist chibi painted style. Image 3 is the EDIT TARGET. Keep its entire upper body, head, costume, fox, snowflake, framing and scale unchanged. Only redraw the legs and the very bottom hem for the next specified genuine walk pose. No copy, mirror, warp, interpolation, or translated pose.
The character RIGHT leg is on SCREEN-LEFT and is swinging FORWARD, with its shin nearly straight and toe pointing toward SCREEN BOTTOM-RIGHT. Its heel HOVERS just a little above ground, not planted yet. The character LEFT leg is on SCREEN-RIGHT trailing BEHIND, heel raised while toe stays grounded and supports body weight. Clear different depth: screen-left right boot is ahead/lower; screen-right left boot behind/higher. Maintain separate tracks, no crossing. This is TWO phases BEFORE image 3 right-heel contact.
Two anatomically connected legs only. Keep same short chibi proportions, camera and facing. Full body isolated on transparent RGBA canvas, native at least 1024 square. Highest finish. No added tail, no floor, shadow, grid or text. Both original boots point in same direction as her nose. At least one foot must support weight on ground. Preserve all identity and accessories exactly.
